{{Short description|American mathematician}}

'''John Boyd Etnyre'''  is an American [[mathematician]] at the [[Georgia Institute of Technology]],<ref>{{Cite web|title=School of Mathematics {{!}} Georgia Institute of Technology {{!}} Atlanta, GA|url=https://math.gatech.edu/people/john-etnyre|access-date=2021-12-21|website=math.gatech.edu|date=20 August 2019 }}</ref> and his research fields include [[contact geometry]], [[symplectic geometry]] and [[low-dimensional topology]]. He earned his Ph.D. in 1996 from the [[University of Texas at Austin|University of Texas]], Austin under the supervision of [[Robert Gompf]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=John Etnyre at the Mathematics Genealogy Project|url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=30245|access-date=2021-12-21|website=www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu}}</ref> Etnyre was a postdoctoral scholar at [[Stanford University]] from 1997 to 2001.<ref name=":0" /> He was a faculty member at the [[University of Pennsylvania]] prior to joining the faculty at the Georgia Institute of Technology.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=John Etnyre (Curriculum Vitae)|url=https://etnyre.math.gatech.edu/professionalstuff/vita.pdf}}</ref>

In 2013, Etnyre was in the Inaugural Class of Fellows of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society|url=https://www.ams.org/cgi-bin/fellows/fellows.cgi|access-date=2021-12-30|website=American Mathematical Society|language=en}}</ref> He received a National Science Foundation CAREER grant award in 2003,<ref>{{Cite web|title=NSF Award Search: Award # 0239600 - CAREER: Knot Theory and Dynamics in Contact Geometry|url=https://nsf.gov/awardsearch/showAward?AWD_ID=0239600&HistoricalAwards=false|access-date=2021-12-21|website=nsf.gov}}</ref> and in 2015-2016, he was a [[Simons Fellow]] in Mathematics.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2012-06-19|title=Simons Fellows in Mathematics|url=https://www.simonsfoundation.org/grant/simons-fellows-in-mathematics/?tab=awardees|access-date=2021-12-30|website=Simons Foundation|language=en-US}}</ref> Etnyre serves as a Principal Editor for the journal of [[Algebraic & Geometric Topology]].<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://msp.org/agt/about/journal/editorial.html|title=Algebraic & Geometric Topology|publisher=Mathematical Sciences Publishers}}</ref>
